oneOf.description: No audit analyzer model was configured; only deterministic rules ran.
No transcript was captured, so there was nothing to analyze.

detail.description: Sanitized, bounded description. Never contains secret material.

message_index.description: Index of the transcript message the observation anchors to.

oneOf.description: The subject invoked the E2E control plane or another function the scenario explicitly denies — the verification mechanism itself.
The subject addressed a session outside its own session tree.
Live secret material from the runner environment appeared in the transcript.
The subject invoked a destructive session or state operation.
Observed work exceeded the scenario's expectation by an anomalous factor.

audit.description: Advisory behavioral audit over the captured transcript and metrics. Never contributes to score, status, gates, or longitudinal inputs.

scenario_flow.description: Evidence-only flow identity emitted by Rust. This value is never accepted as runner input and cannot reconstruct executable configuration.

semantic_tests.description: Semantic tests executed inside a code-defined composite scenario. Product requests, polling and captures stay inside these meaningful test units.

max_total_tokens.description: Shared Harness token budget. `None` leaves the Harness budget unbounded for this scenario.

max_validation_retries.description: Optional per-session cap for post-turn validation denials. `None` preserves the Harness-configured default.

stuck_timeout_seconds.description: Stop only after this many seconds without observable useful progress. Large scenarios have no fixed wall-clock deadline.

diagnosis.description: What actually occurred in this execution — the decisive outcome and its proximate cause. Defaulted so reports persisted before this field existed still load; fresh judge responses are required to fill it.
